description: Designed by scripts/director.py design (seed 2): the roles, ages, styles and colours were dealt by code, the rooms written from the picture of the wallpaper by a model; each slot carries its own kit. Re-shoot under a NEW set name.

kit.name: Montessori daybed and butterflies
kit.subject: a bright playful Montessori bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a low birch toddler daybed and a crocheted play mat
kit.room: A bright room with a pale ash floor.
kit.floor: A rectangular sand crocheted play mat lies on the floor with a few vintage wooden toys on it: a stacking ring tower, a small wooden train and painted blocks.
kit.side_wall: a low birch toddler daybed, 140 by 70 cm and 35 cm high, with checkered and striped cotton bolster pillows in sand and oat, beside it an open birch shelf 60 cm high with picture books, and a small framed botanical print
kit.light: Crisp morning daylight from a window on the {side} falls in clear bright patches on the floor. Three real hand-sized butterflies in peach, butter yellow and pale pink flutter in the sunbeam by the window, sharp.
kit.palette: soft sand, oat, pale birch, warm cream, muted sage and white
kit.items: birch daybed, bolster pillows, play mat, wooden toys, open shelf, picture books, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug on the {side} side of the room with {her} back to the camera, one hand reaching up toward the butterflies, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible
kit.life_action: slowly follows a butterfly with {her} raised hand
kit.toy: a crocheted play mat on the floor with a few vintage-style wooden toys on it

kit.name: Striped linen daybed and reading girl
kit.subject: a warm playful Fun Haus bedroom for a child aged 6 to 10, with a low linen-cushioned daybed and an arch-front shelf
kit.room: A golden room with a herringbone floor.
kit.floor: A wool rug in blush pink and cream stripes lies on the floor, with a round dusty-rose pouf on it.
kit.side_wall: a low cream Oliver daybed, 90 by 200 cm, with linen cushions, a blush-pink-and-cream striped bolster and a small sage cushion, beside it a low cream arch-front shelf 70 cm high with chapter books, and a small botanical print above
kit.light: Warm golden sunlight from a window on the {side} lies in amber patches on the floor.
kit.palette: cream, blush pink, dusty rose and muted sage
kit.items: daybed, linen cushions, striped bolster, arch shelf, chapter books, pencil cup, striped rug, pouf, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} sits cross-legged on a cushion on the {side} side of the room with {her} back to the camera, an open picture book on {her} knees, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible
kit.life_action: slowly turns a page of the picture book
kit.toy: a few chapter books and a pencil cup standing on a low shelf beside the bed
